item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, reconstruct the Urdu from its Roman transcription, and check that the two versions align stanza by stanza.

item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Aise Hum Saqi E Kausar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain Mir Hasan Mir"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Akbar"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Jis Tarha Piyase Samandur Ki dTaraf Dekhte Hain.
Yaad Aata Hai Humein Tera(13) Rajab Ka Manzar.
Jab Bhi Allah Tere Ghar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.
Khud Samaj Jata Hai Malik Ka Ishara Malik.
Bas Ali Malik-e-Ashtar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.
Ayatein Hoon Ya Muhammad Hoon Amaan Ki Khatir.
Fatima Zahra Ki Chadar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.
Jab Nusehri Mere Mula Ko Khuda Kehta Hai.
Hans Ke Salman Abuzar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.
Hosla Apna Barhane Ke Liye Mushkil Mein.
Anbiya Khud Ali Asghar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.
Ruk Ja Aye Maut Ziyarat Ka Maza Lene De.
Hum Abhi Chehra-e-Haider Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.
Lafz Khud Aal-e-Muhammad Ki Sana Mein Akbar.
Joor Kar Hath Sukhnwar Ki Taraf Dekhte Hain.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aise-hum-saqi-e-kausar-ki-taraf-dekhte-hain-mir-hasan-mir-tajpoints-a15527d8f8386e24201b.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines()
urdu = body.strip().splitlines()
assert roman[0] == '  1' and urdu[0] == '۱'
assert len(roman) == len(urdu) == 16
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman)
assert all(any('\\u0600' <= c <= '\\u06ff' for c in line) for line in urdu[1:])
assert '\\u200c' not in body and 'noUrdu' not in front
print('Verified one stanza with 15 verses in each edition.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 15 verses in Urdu script and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions retain the single stanza and verse order.

Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, added the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`. Read `Tera(13)` as `تیرہ` and `Nusehri` as `نصیری`. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
